import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'survived': [0, 1, 1, 1, 0],
    'pclass': [3, 1, 3, 1, 3],
    'sex': ['male', 'female', 'female', 'female', 'male'],
    'age': [22.0, 38.0, 26.0, 35.0, 35.0],
    'sibsp': [1, 1, 0, 1, 0],
    'parch': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'fare': [7.25, 71.2833, 7.925, 53.1, 8.05],
    'embarked': ['S', 'C', 'S', 'S', 'S'],
    'class': ['Third', 'First', 'Third', 'First', 'Third'],
    'who': ['man', 'woman', 'woman', 'woman', 'man'],
    'adult_male': [True, False, False, False, True],
    'deck': ['', 'C', '', 'C', ''],
    'embark_town': ['Southampton', 'Cherbourg', 'Southampton', 'Southampton', 'Southampton'],
    'alive': ['no', 'yes', 'yes', 'yes', 'no'],
    'alone': [False, False, True, False, True]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Set up the visualization
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Passenger Data Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Survival by class and gender
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
survival_data = df.groupby(['class', 'sex', 'alive']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
survival_data.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#e74c3c', '#2ecc71'])
ax1.set_title('Survival by Class and Gender')
ax1.set_xlabel('Class & Gender')
ax1.set_ylabel('Count')
ax1.legend(title='Survived')
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Age distribution by survival
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
survived_ages = df[df['alive'] == 'yes']['age']
not_survived_ages = df[df['alive'] == 'no']['age']
ax2.hist([survived_ages, not_survived_ages], bins=5, label=['Survived', 'Not Survived'], 
         color=['#2ecc71', '#e74c3c'], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age')
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency')
ax2.legend()

# 3. Fare distribution by class
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
class_order = ['First', 'Third']
fare_data = [df[df['class'] == cls]['fare'] for cls in class_order]
box = ax3.boxplot(fare_data, labels=class_order, patch_artist=True)
colors = ['#3498db', '#f39c12']
for patch, color in zip(box['boxes'], colors):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)
ax3.set_title('Fare Distribution by Class')
ax3.set_ylabel('Fare')
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 4. Survival rate by embarkation port
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
if not df['embark_town'].empty:
    embark_survival = df.groupby('embark_town')['alive'].apply(
        lambda x: (x == 'yes').sum() / len(x) * 100
    ).sort_values()
    bars = ax4.bar(embark_survival.index, embark_survival.values, color=['#9b59b6', '#1abc9c'])
    ax4.set_title('Survival Rate by Embarkation Port')
    ax4.set_xlabel('Embarkation Port')
    ax4.set_ylabel('Survival Rate (%)')
    ax4.set_ylim(0, 100)
    for bar in bars:
        height = bar.get_height()
        ax4.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 2,
                f'{height:.1f}%', ha='center', va='bottom')

# 5. Family size analysis
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
df['family_size'] = df['sibsp'] + df['parch'] + 1
family_survival = df.groupby('family_size')['alive'].apply(
    lambda x: (x == 'yes').mean() * 100
)
ax5.plot(family_survival.index, family_survival.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, color='#e67e22')
ax5.set_title('Survival Rate by Family Size')
ax5.set_xlabel('Family Size')
ax5.set_ylabel('Survival Rate (%)')
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax5.set_xticks(sorted(df['family_size'].unique()))

# 6. Gender distribution with survival
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
gender_survival = pd.crosstab(df['sex'], df['alive'], normalize='index') * 100
gender_survival.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=ax6, color=['#e74c3c', '#2ecc71'])
ax6.set_title('Gender Distribution with Survival')
ax6.set_xlabel('Gender')
ax6.set_ylabel('Percentage (%)')
ax6.legend(title='Survived', loc='upper right')
ax6.set_ylim(0, 100)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
